title: Ayro caxaaxuwi iraawoh gubat
intro: Ubkak naharal baxsimeh yan roocih aydaadu, diini gidaaritteh addat qarseenih yaniinim kee baad qigdu yuble weeh yan asta yabbixeenimih doorimte. malkit kulli afkanal ugte wak, xongolo kak temeetem mangom celtam duude wayta arooca inkih tan shakki tibba hayta. atu geytam duuddaa miyyi gexem ayro caxaaxuwi silaalak gubal?
clues: Anu qemmoh ufuy ruubaamak afal, yoo quuke num abeh yan xagana, kulliimih ayfaafayah gulguluh suge.
Anu qibaadah aracak diini footimaamih addat gitah yan dacrisah hanaawih gubat yenbe.
faxe wak yi dacrise yi footima fan yamaate wak, usuk yollih gee waktitteh xayyos too takkem faxxiimak masuginna.
Anu baxi rufto le xaagu yomcowwe, tonnal yi caalat xagana kah heenih footima macabinna.
Anu baxxo le arac fan gexeeh, tokkel ayro caxah caxa iraawo yoh teceeh, gubal weeqayti caxitta wak.
Accusation temeeteeh, esseroora yoo culte wak, anu inni qusba awka wagsiisak — kee usuk kulli shakki tibba exceh, qarwaak yaabe.

outcome.label: Xalu
options: kunnabna inkih tan sayyoh fayya le

Jinniiy, seehadayti baxaa kee caacayitteh amol reeda yeceenih yaniinim
outcome.answer: kunnabna inkih tan sayyoh fayya le

arabic: فَنَادَىٰهَا مِن تَحْتِهَآ أَلَّا تَحْزَنِى قَدْ جَعَلَ رَبُّكِ تَحْتَكِ سَرِيًّۭا
verse: But he called her from below her, "Do not grieve; your Lord has provided beneath you a stream. (19:24)
